SC-https-denied.acceptance: CONNECT is denied and the source records zero connections.

SC-http-miss.acceptance: Both variants contact the source. Received content follows the configured cache/privacy policy and passes client verification before use; unsigned or expired metadata is rejected unless explicitly excepted.

SC-http-cache-untrusted.acceptance: The client rejects the content before use and the source records zero new requests.

SC-http-denied.acceptance: Each request is denied. The source records zero requests; cached content is not returned.

SC-http-untrusted.acceptance: The client rejects the content before use; retrieval alone does not count as verification.

SC-https.acceptance: Client TLS authenticates the source certificate and hostname end to end. The proxy neither inspects nor caches decrypted payload; client content verification succeeds before use.
SC-https.manual: Run the Stage 1 accepted-source HTTPS retrieval on the deployed route; verify source certificate/hostname, payload integrity and refusal of invalid trust. The isolated HTTP fixture does not forward CONNECT.

SC-http-hit.acceptance: No additional source request occurs. The client verifies the returned content before accepting it.

SC-http-source-failure.acceptance: Retrieval reports failure, delivers no usable content, performs zero content-verification checks and does not serve a stale fallback.
